name: Rainbow Chocolates #25
description:
A blister pack containing six spherical chocolates, each wrapped in a glossy coating that continuously cycles through colors. Once consumed, chocolates emit a flavor associated with the current color instead of typical chocolate taste.

EFFECT: Subjects experience taste sensations matching the visible color of the chocolate at consumption time, with flavors ranging from savory to sweet.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: The chocolates change color every five seconds when exposed to light, cycling through the visible spectrum. Once consumed, the chocolates provide a distinct flavor corresponding to their color at the moment of ingestion.
TASTE: Variable, determined by the color of each chocolate.
PACKAGING: A blister pack containing six individual compartments, each with a small, round chocolate covered in a vivid, glossy wrapper. The wrappers shift in a gradient of colors, displaying random patterns of geometric shapes. The text '色彩豐富' ('Colorful') is printed in bright lettering across the top.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Could be a fun addition to Foundation team parties—or how to ensure enduring color-themed disputes.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-20 — edition #25 of the permanent record.
